paraphrase: The six tīrthika teachers, losing support to the Buddha, challenge him to a contest of wonders at Śrāvastī; the Buddha performs the great miracle and the tīrthikas are routed; Pūraṇa drowns himself.
notes: Reported by an opponent: the Divyāvadāna (Mūlasarvāstivāda legend). Prātihārya-sūtra; details from memory.

paraphrase: In the Aśoka cycle, when a follower of the Nirgrantha at Puṇḍravardhana drew the Buddha bowing at the Nirgrantha's feet, Aśoka ordered the Ājīvikas there to be killed; later his own brother Vītāśoka was killed in a similar persecution, after which Aśoka forbade such killing.
notes: Reported by an opponent: the Divyāvadāna (Buddhist legend). Recalled with low confidence (Vītāśokāvadāna); versions differ between Ājīvika and Nirgrantha. A legend, not a historical record; recorded as the tradition's account.
